board.why: Exchanges read-only onboarding-status and pending-bill-count answers with HireScope

pulls.purpose: Ask HireScope for onboarding status and answer its fixed pending-bill-count question
Confirm to Steward that Bills Tracker deleted a business's locally stored bill records
Read a signed Board mention before matching a HireScope answer or validating the fixed pending-bill-count question
Propose a pay-invoice task for an owner or admin to approve
Group up to 25 pay-invoice task proposals for one owner or admin review
Link an accepted task proposal to the local bill that created it
Reconcile each pay-invoice task proposal after its grouped review is decided
Let an owner or admin choose the member who should receive a bill task
Choose the Steward company in which a bill task is created

events.purpose: Read and display matched HireScope answers, and answer HireScope's fixed pending-bill-count question without changing bill records
Delete locally stored bill records when a Steward business is purged
Delete locally stored bill records when an owner disables Bills Tracker with deletion
Record whether Steward created or rejected a proposed bill task
Record which bill tasks Steward created or rejected from a grouped review
Update the linked bill when its Steward task changes or completes

stores.what: Bills, payment amounts, deadlines, payment status, Steward task/proposal identifiers, and display-only HireScope board questions and answers

returns.purpose: Pay-invoice tasks for a Steward member, created only after owner or admin approval
